---
title: "Biosignals2 — Facial Expression Analysis (FaceReader + webcam biometrics)"
author: ""
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    code_folding: show
params:
  bin_s: 0.1              # common time grid (s) both sources are averaged onto
  min_valid_prop: 0.5     # drop an epoch/source if < this share of bins has a tracked face
  video_trim_s: 0         # ignore the first N s of each video (orienting / onset artefacts)
  max_clock_resid_s: 0.05   # warn if the PsychoPy→recording clock fit is off by more than this for any row
  wc_shift_s: 0           # added to webcam times to cancel a constant FaceReader–webcam lag (see §8.1)
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5)
```

> **What this document does.** It reads, per participant,
>
> 1. the **FaceReader detailed log** (`.xlsx` or `.txt` export),
> 2. the **webcam-biometrics log** (`*_biometrics.csv`, MediaPipe/ARKit blendshapes),
> 3. the **PsychoPy data file** (`.csv`) — epoch timings *and* the video ratings,
> 4. for older sessions, the webcam **frame timestamps** (`<id>_frame_timestamps.csv`),
>
> puts everything on one clock (seconds since webcam recording start), cuts it
> into baseline / video / recovery epochs, and then tests
> **(A)** positive vs negative condition effects,
> **(B)** agreement between FaceReader and the webcam blendshapes, and
> **(C)** whether per-video expression tracks the stimulus self-report ratings.
>
> Both recording formats are handled:
>
> * **current** (`png2avi`, e.g. i4155, r4755): FaceReader ran on `<id>_facereader.avi`,
>   rebuilt so that video time = time since recording start;
> * **older** (`legacy`, e.g. e5510, g2313, n2026, p7259, s0943): FaceReader ran on
>   `<id>_recording.avi`, whose video time drifts from real time — each FaceReader
>   frame is mapped back to its real capture time with the frame-timestamps file.
>
> Pilot-sized N: the inferential tests are a scaffold. Read them as descriptive
> until the full sample is in.

---

## 0. Participants and settings

**Edit this chunk to exclude participants.** Write each ID (as in the file
names, any case) with the reason, separated by commas — no comma after the last
one. Excluded participants are not loaded at all and are listed with their
reason in the participant overview (§3.7).

```{r settings}
exclude_participants <- c(
  # g2313 = "webcam ran below 20 fps",
  # e5510 = "restarted session"
)
# Use this list only for exclusions specific to the facial analysis. Pilots, test sessions
# and rejected participants come from analysis/participant_status.csv automatically.
# Main-study participants only by default; set TRUE to also analyse the pilots.
INCLUDE_PILOTS <- FALSE

# Which recording formats to include: "png2avi" (current) and/or "legacy" (older)
include_formats <- c("png2avi", "legacy")
```

## 1. Packages & config

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)   # dplyr >= 1.1 needed for join_by(between())
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)        # mixed models (optional; skipped if too few participants)
library(readxl)      # blendshape → AU lookup table
```

Paths come from the repo's `config.R` (found by searching upward from this
file, like the other analysis Rmds). Variables used:

| variable | used for | if not defined in `config.R` |
|---|---|---|
| `PSYCHOPY_DATA_DIR` | PsychoPy `.csv`, `*_biometrics.csv`, `*_clocksync.json` | required |
| `FACEREADER_RESULTS_DIR` | FaceReader detailed logs (`.xlsx`/`.txt`) | required |
| `VIDEO_DIR` | older sessions: `<id>_frame_timestamps.csv` | older sessions are dropped |
| `FACIAL_EXPRESSION_DIR` | outputs of this analysis | `SERVER_ROOT/facial_expression` |
| `AU_LOOKUP_PATH` | `blendshapes_au_lookup.xlsx` | `analysis/video/`, then `analysis/` |

```{r config}
# Directory of this .Rmd: knitr's input dir when knitting, RStudio's editor path
# when running chunks interactively, otherwise the working directory.
rmd_dir <- function() {
  d <- tryCatch(dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(d) || !nzchar(d) || d == ".") {
    d <- tryCatch(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path),
                  error = function(e) NULL)
  }
  if (is.null(d) || !nzchar(d)) d <- getwd()
  normalizePath(d, winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
}

find_upward <- function(start, filename) {
  current <- start
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(current, filename))) return(current)
    parent <- dirname(current)
    if (parent == current) {
      stop("Could not find ", filename, " in ", start, " or any parent directory.\n",
           "Copy config_template.R -> config.R at the repo root and fill in SERVER_ROOT.")
    }
    current <- parent
  }
}

analysis_dir <- rmd_dir()
project_dir  <- find_upward(analysis_dir, "config.R")
source(file.path(project_dir, "config.R"))

need <- c("PSYCHOPY_DATA_DIR", "FACEREADER_RESULTS_DIR")
missing_vars <- need[!vapply(need, exists, logical(1))]
if (length(missing_vars)) stop("config.R does not define: ", paste(missing_vars, collapse = ", "))

psychopy_dir   <- PSYCHOPY_DATA_DIR
facereader_dir <- FACEREADER_RESULTS_DIR
legacy_dir     <- if (exists("VIDEO_DIR")) VIDEO_DIR else NA_character_
output_dir     <- if (exists("FACIAL_EXPRESSION_DIR")) FACIAL_EXPRESSION_DIR else
                    file.path(SERVER_ROOT, "facial_expression")
au_lookup_path <- if (exists("AU_LOOKUP_PATH")) AU_LOOKUP_PATH else {
  cands <- file.path(analysis_dir, c("video", "."), "blendshapes_au_lookup.xlsx")
  cands[file.exists(cands)][1]
}

tibble(setting = c("config.R", "psychopy_dir", "facereader_dir", "legacy frame timestamps (VIDEO_DIR)",
                   "output_dir", "au_lookup"),
       path    = c(file.path(project_dir, "config.R"), psychopy_dir, facereader_dir, legacy_dir,
                   output_dir, au_lookup_path),
       exists  = file.exists(path)) |>
  kable()

# Add participants left out by participant_status.csv (pilots unless INCLUDE_PILOTS,
# test sessions, rejected participants). Entries above take precedence.
PARTICIPANT_STATUS_PATH <- file.path(analysis_dir, "participant_status.csv")
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "participant_status.R"), local = TRUE)
from_status <- PARTICIPANT_STATUS[!participant_keep(PARTICIPANT_STATUS$participant_id, INCLUDE_PILOTS), ]
from_status <- setNames(paste0(from_status$status,
                               ifelse(nzchar(from_status$reason), paste0(": ", from_status$reason), ""),
                               " (participant_status.csv)"),
                        tolower(from_status$participant_id))
exclude_participants <- c(exclude_participants,
                          from_status[!names(from_status) %in% tolower(names(exclude_participants))])

excluded_ids <- tolower(names(exclude_participants))
if (length(exclude_participants) && any(!nzchar(excluded_ids))) {
  stop("Every entry in exclude_participants needs an ID, e.g.  g2313 = \"reason\"")
}

if (is.na(au_lookup_path) || !file.exists(au_lookup_path)) {
  stop("blendshapes_au_lookup.xlsx not found — put it in analysis/video/ or set AU_LOOKUP_PATH in config.R.")
}
```

## 2. Helper functions

### 2.1 General

```{r helpers-general}
# Participant ID: text before the first "_" of the file name, lower case
# (same rule as video/001_generate_event_onsets.py).
pid_from_file <- function(path) tolower(sub("_.*$", "", basename(gsub("\\\\", "/", path))))

# Return a column if it exists, otherwise NA (PsychoPy columns vary by version).
col_or_na <- function(df, name) if (name %in% names(df)) df[[name]] else rep(NA, nrow(df))

num <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(str_replace(as.character(x), ",", ".")))

# Mean of available columns, row-wise; NA if none present / all NA.
row_mean <- function(df, cols) {
  cols <- intersect(cols, names(df))
  if (length(cols) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, nrow(df)))
  out <- rowMeans(as.matrix(df[cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
  out[is.nan(out)] <- NA_real_
  out
}
```

### 2.2 FaceReader detailed log

Layout (checked against participant r4755, FaceReader "General" face model,
continuous calibration): a few metadata rows (`Filename`, `Frame rate`, …),
blank rows, then a header row starting with `Video Time` (`hh:mm:ss.fff`).
Columns used: the 7 emotions (no Contempt in this model), `Valence`, `Arousal`,
`Quality`, and the action units — bilateral (`Action Unit 12 - Lip Corner Puller`)
plus left/right versions for some. Failed frames are `FIND_FAILED` / `FIT_FAILED`
in every column. Heart-rate/breathing columns are ignored.

Both the Excel export and the tab-delimited `.txt` export are read. AU letter
codes (`A`–`E`), if a different export setting produces them, are mapped to
bin midpoints.

**Participant ID** comes from the `Filename` row (`…\r4755_facereader.avi` → `r4755`),
not the export's file name — FaceReader names sheets "Participant 2", which is
its internal numbering and does not match yours.

```{r helpers-facereader}
au_letter_values <- c(NotActive = 0, A = 0.11, B = 0.35, C = 0.62, D = 0.85, E = 0.97)

parse_au <- function(x) {
  x   <- str_trim(as.character(x))
  out <- num(x)
  is_letter <- x %in% names(au_letter_values)
  out[is_letter] <- au_letter_values[x[is_letter]]
  out
}

# "hh:mm:ss.fff" -> s. If Excel turned the cell into a time, it arrives as a day fraction.
fr_time_to_s <- function(x) {
  x <- str_replace(as.character(x), ",", ".")
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  hms <- str_detect(x, ":")
  parts <- str_split_fixed(x[hms], ":", 3)
  out[hms]  <- as.numeric(parts[, 1]) * 3600 + as.numeric(parts[, 2]) * 60 + as.numeric(parts[, 3])
  out[!hms] <- num(x[!hms]) * 86400
  out
}

clean_fr_names <- function(x) {
  au <- str_match(x, "^Action Unit (\\d+)(?: - (Left|Right))? - ")
  generic <- x |> tolower() |> str_replace_all("[^a-z0-9]+", "_") |> str_remove_all("^_|_$")
  ifelse(!is.na(au[, 1]),
         paste0("au", str_pad(au[, 2], 2, pad = "0"),
                ifelse(is.na(au[, 3]), "", paste0("_", tolower(au[, 3])))),
         generic)
}

# Returns a character matrix-like tibble of the whole sheet/file, no header.
read_fr_grid <- function(path) {
  if (str_detect(path, "\\.xlsx?$")) {
    read_excel(path, sheet = 1, col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text",
               .name_repair = "minimal", progress = FALSE)
  } else {
    lines <- sub("^\ufeff", "", readLines(path, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"))
    read_tsv(I(paste(lines, collapse = "\n")), col_names = FALSE,
             col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), progress = FALSE)
  }
}

read_facereader <- function(path) {
  grid <- read_fr_grid(path)
  hdr  <- which(grid[[1]] == "Video Time")[1]
  if (is.na(hdr)) stop("No 'Video Time' header row in ", basename(path),
                       " — is this a FaceReader *detailed* log?")

  meta     <- grid[seq_len(hdr - 1), 1:2] |> setNames(c("key", "value")) |> drop_na(key)
  get_meta <- function(k) meta$value[str_detect(meta$key, regex(k, ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
  src_file <- get_meta("^file ?name")
  pid      <- if (!is.na(src_file)) pid_from_file(str_trim(src_file)) else pid_from_file(path)

  df <- grid[-seq_len(hdr), ]
  names(df) <- clean_fr_names(as.character(unlist(grid[hdr, ])))
  df <- df[, !is.na(names(df)) & nzchar(names(df))]
  df <- df[!is.na(df$video_time), ]

  emo_cols <- intersect(c("neutral", "happy", "sad", "angry", "surprised", "scared",
                          "disgusted", "contempt", "valence", "arousal", "quality"), names(df))
  au_cols  <- str_subset(names(df), "^au\\d{2}")

  out <- tibble(
    participant_id = pid,
    rec_time       = fr_time_to_s(df$video_time),   # AVI time == time since recording start
    fr_valid       = !is.na(num(df$neutral))        # FIND_FAILED / FIT_FAILED -> FALSE
  ) |>
    bind_cols(
      df[emo_cols] |> mutate(across(everything(), num))     |> rename_with(~ paste0("fr_", .x)),
      df[au_cols]  |> mutate(across(everything(), parse_au)) |> rename_with(~ paste0("fr_", .x))
    )
  attr(out, "meta") <- tibble(participant_id = pid, file = basename(path),
                              source_video = src_file,
                              frame_rate = num(get_meta("^frame rate")),
                              face_model = get_meta("^face model"),
                              calibration = get_meta("^calibration"))
  out
}
```

### 2.3 Webcam biometrics log

One row per browser frame (~30 fps). `time` is the **capture** time already
mapped onto PsychoPy's `globalClock`; `mono_time` is `core.getTime()` at
*arrival* (~10 ms later — network latency). `face` is `True`/`False`;
blendshapes are empty when no face was detected. Gaze/HR columns are not used here.

```{r helpers-webcam}
read_biometrics <- function(path) {
  df <- read_csv(path, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()), progress = FALSE)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    warning("Empty biometrics log (header only): ", basename(path))
    return(NULL)
  }
  df |>
    transmute(
      time         = num(time),
      mono_time    = num(mono_time),
      wc_valid     = face %in% c("True", "TRUE", "true", "1"),
      across(starts_with("bs_"), num)
    )
}
```

### 2.4 Mapping blendshapes onto FACS action units and emotions

The mapping comes from `blendshapes_au_lookup.xlsx`. Per blendshape it gives
the probable FACS AU (column B) and an emotion code (column D: 0 = neutral,
1 = positive, 2 = anger, 3 = fear, 4 = surprise, 5 = sadness, 6 = disgust).

Parsing rules:

* The AU number is the first `AU<n>` in column B. Rows starting "Not", "No direct",
  or with no AU number (eye movements, lateral jaw/mouth, `mouthClose`) get no AU.
* Left/right blendshapes that map to the same AU are averaged.
* An AU is flagged `approximate` if column B or C says approx./partial/not standard.
* Webcam **emotion scores** = mean of the blendshapes coded with that emotion
  (code 0 is not scored). These are single-blendshape assignments, not FACS
  emotion prototypes, so treat them as rough.

```{r au-map}
emotion_codes <- c(`1` = "positive", `2` = "anger", `3` = "fear", `4` = "surprise",
                   `5` = "sadness", `6` = "disgust")

au_lookup_raw <- read_excel(au_lookup_path, .name_repair = "minimal")
au_lookup_raw <- au_lookup_raw[, nzchar(names(au_lookup_raw))]

bs_lookup <- au_lookup_raw |>
  transmute(
    blendshape     = str_trim(Blendshape),
    au_text        = `Probable FACS Action Unit(s)`,
    notes          = `Uncertainty / Notes`,
    emotion_code   = as.integer(Emotions),
    emotion_likely = as.integer(str_extract(`Most Likely Emotion`, "^\\d+")),
    au_num         = if_else(str_detect(au_text, "^(Not|No direct)"), NA_character_,
                             str_match(au_text, "AU(\\d+)")[, 2]),
    au             = if_else(is.na(au_num), NA_character_,
                             paste0("au", str_pad(au_num, 2, pad = "0"))),
    label          = str_match(au_text, "\\(([^,)]+)")[, 2] |> str_trim(),
    label          = if_else(is.na(label) | str_detect(label, "^approx"),
                             str_match(au_text, "^AU\\d+/?\\s*([^(]+)")[, 2] |> str_trim(),
                             label),
    approximate    = str_detect(paste(au_text, notes),
                                regex("approx|partial|not standard", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    emotion        = unname(emotion_codes[as.character(emotion_code)])
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(blendshape), blendshape != "")

bs_to_au <- bs_lookup |>
  filter(!is.na(au)) |>
  group_by(au) |>
  summarise(label       = first(label),
            blendshapes = list(str_remove(blendshape, "^bs_")),
            approximate = any(approximate), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(au)

bs_to_emotion <- bs_lookup |>
  filter(!is.na(emotion)) |>
  group_by(emotion) |>
  summarise(blendshapes = list(str_remove(blendshape, "^bs_")), .groups = "drop")

bs_to_au |>
  mutate(blendshapes = map_chr(blendshapes, paste, collapse = ", ")) |>
  kable(caption = "Blendshape → AU mapping used for the webcam")
```

Rows where the lookup's two emotion columns disagree (D = code used here,
H = "Most Likely Emotion"). Worth resolving in the spreadsheet:

```{r au-map-check}
bs_lookup |>
  filter(emotion_code != emotion_likely) |>
  select(blendshape, au_text, emotion_code, emotion_likely) |>
  kable()
```

```{r wc-derived}
add_wc_aus <- function(df) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(bs_to_au))) {
    df[[paste0("wc_", bs_to_au$au[i])]] <- row_mean(df, paste0("bs_", bs_to_au$blendshapes[[i]]))
  }
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(bs_to_emotion))) {
    df[[paste0("wc_emo_", bs_to_emotion$emotion[i])]] <-
      row_mean(df, paste0("bs_", bs_to_emotion$blendshapes[[i]]))
  }
  df
}

# Composites computed identically for both sources, so they are comparable.
#   smile = mean(AU6, AU12)          — Duchenne-type positive expression
#   frown = mean(AU4, AU9, AU15)     — brow lowering / nose wrinkle / lip depressor
#   au_valence = smile - frown       — crude, *heuristic* valence proxy
add_composites <- function(df, prefix) {
  au <- function(x) paste0(prefix, x)
  df[[au("smile")]]      <- row_mean(df, au(c("au06", "au12")))
  df[[au("frown")]]      <- row_mean(df, au(c("au04", "au09", "au15")))
  df[[au("au_valence")]] <- df[[au("smile")]] - df[[au("frown")]]
  df
}
```

## 3. Load data

### 3.1 PsychoPy sessions

A **session** = one PsychoPy data file. Its `_biometrics.csv` and
`_clocksync.json` share the same file stem. The recording format is detected
from the columns: `stim_onset_since_rec_start` → current (`png2avi`);
only `time_since_recording_start` → older (`legacy`); neither → no webcam
timing (e.g. a session without camera, or an aborted run).

```{r load-psychopy}
psy_files <- list.files(psychopy_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE) |>
  str_subset("_(biometrics|frame_timestamps|frame_map)\\.csv$", negate = TRUE)
if (length(psy_files) == 0) stop("No PsychoPy .csv files in: ", psychopy_dir)

read_psy <- function(path) {
  raw <- tryCatch(read_csv(path, col_types = cols(.default = col_character()),
                           name_repair = "minimal", progress = FALSE),
                  error = function(e) tibble())
  if (ncol(raw) == 0) return(raw)
  names(raw)[1] <- sub("^﻿", "", names(raw)[1])
  raw[, nzchar(names(raw))]
}

session_format <- function(raw) {
  has_vals <- function(col) any(!is.na(num(col_or_na(raw, col))))
  if (nrow(raw) == 0) NA_character_
  else if (has_vals("stim_onset_since_rec_start")) "png2avi"
  else if (has_vals("time_since_recording_start")) "legacy"
  else NA_character_
}

find_frames <- function(pid) {
  if (is.na(legacy_dir) || !dir.exists(legacy_dir)) return(NA_character_)
  hits <- list.files(legacy_dir, pattern = "frame_timestamps\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  hits <- hits[pid_from_file(hits) == pid]
  if (length(hits) == 1) hits else NA_character_
}

all_sessions <- tibble(psy_path = psy_files) |>
  mutate(
    session_stem   = sub("\\.csv$", "", basename(psy_path)),
    participant_id = pid_from_file(psy_path)
  ) |>
  filter(!participant_id %in% excluded_ids) |>          # user exclusions: not even read
  mutate(
    raw    = map(psy_path, read_psy),
    format = map_chr(raw, session_format)
  )

# One usable session per participant. Several (e.g. a restarted run) can't be told
# apart automatically: the participant is dropped and listed so you can move the
# wrong file out of the folder.
usable <- all_sessions |> filter(!is.na(format))
multi  <- usable |> count(participant_id) |> filter(n > 1) |> pull(participant_id)

sessions <- usable |>
  filter(!participant_id %in% multi, format %in% include_formats) |>
  mutate(
    bio_path    = file.path(psychopy_dir, paste0(session_stem, "_biometrics.csv")),
    sync_path   = file.path(psychopy_dir, paste0(session_stem, "_clocksync.json")),
    has_bio     = file.exists(bio_path) & file.size(bio_path) > 0,
    has_sync    = file.exists(sync_path),
    frames_path = if_else(format == "legacy", map_chr(participant_id, find_frames), NA_character_)
  )

# Status of every participant found, filled in as data is loaded (shown in §3.7)
overview <- all_sessions |>
  group_by(participant_id) |>
  summarise(psychopy_files = n(),
            format = paste(unique(na.omit(format)), collapse = "/"),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(status = case_when(
    participant_id %in% multi ~ "dropped: several usable PsychoPy files - move the wrong one out",
    format == ""              ~ "dropped: no webcam timing columns (no camera / aborted run)",
    !str_detect(format, paste(include_formats, collapse = "|")) ~ "dropped: format not in include_formats",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_))

sessions |> select(participant_id, format, session_stem, has_bio, has_sync, frames_path) |>
  mutate(frames_path = basename(frames_path)) |>
  kable(caption = "Sessions to analyse")
```

### 3.2 Clock alignment

Two clocks matter:

* **globalClock** — PsychoPy's `*.started`/`*.stopped` columns and the webcam `time` column.
* **recording clock** — seconds since webcam recording start.

Each logged epoch row carries its routine's start on *both* clocks: the routine's
`.started` (globalClock) and `stim_onset_since_rec_start` (current) or
`time_since_recording_start` (older), both taken at routine start. A straight
line `rec = a + b × global` is fitted through these 7 points per session. For
current sessions both are PsychoPy clocks, so `b` = 1 exactly. Older sessions
used the computer's wall clock for the recording, which can tick at a very
slightly different rate — the slope absorbs that. The largest residual is the
alignment error.

```{r clock-offset}
routine_start_global <- function(raw) {
  coalesce(num(col_or_na(raw, "stimuli.started")),
           num(col_or_na(raw, "stim_recovery.started")),
           num(col_or_na(raw, "baseline.started")))
}

fit_clock <- function(raw, format) {
  since <- num(col_or_na(raw, if (format == "png2avi") "stim_onset_since_rec_start"
                              else "time_since_recording_start"))
  glob  <- routine_start_global(raw)
  ok    <- !is.na(since) & !is.na(glob)
  since <- since[ok]; glob <- glob[ok]
  if (length(since) == 0) return(tibble(n_rows = 0L, a = NA_real_, b = NA_real_,
                                        max_resid_ms = NA_real_))
  if (length(since) < 3) {
    b <- 1; a <- median(since - glob)
  } else {
    co <- coef(lm(since ~ glob)); a <- co[[1]]; b <- co[[2]]
  }
  tibble(n_rows = length(since), a = a, b = b,
         max_resid_ms = 1000 * max(abs(since - (a + b * glob))))
}

to_rec <- function(t_global, a, b) a + b * t_global

clock <- sessions |>
  mutate(fit = map2(raw, format, fit_clock)) |>
  select(participant_id, session_stem, format, fit) |>
  unnest(fit) |>
  mutate(drift_ms_per_10min = 1000 * (b - 1) * 600)

clock |>
  select(participant_id, format, n_rows, a, drift_ms_per_10min, max_resid_ms) |>
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "rec_time = a + b × globalClock (drift = (b − 1) × 10 min)")

bad_clock <- clock |> filter(is.na(a))
clock    <- clock    |> filter(!is.na(a))
sessions <- sessions |> filter(session_stem %in% clock$session_stem)
overview <- overview |>
  mutate(status = if_else(is.na(status) & participant_id %in% bad_clock$participant_id,
                          "dropped: no epoch rows with both clocks", status))
if (nrow(sessions) == 0) stop("No sessions left to analyse.")
if (any(clock$max_resid_ms / 1000 > params$max_clock_resid_s)) {
  warning("Clock fit off by more than ", params$max_clock_resid_s * 1000,
          " ms for some sessions — check timing before trusting alignment.")
}
```

### 3.3 Epochs

Epoch boundaries use the **component** times, converted to the recording clock:

| epoch     | start                           | end                              |
|-----------|---------------------------------|----------------------------------|
| baseline  | `fixation_baseline.started`     | `fixation_baseline.stopped`      |
| video     | `video.started`                 | `stimuli.stopped`                |
| recovery  | `fixation_stim_recovery.started`| `fixation_stim_recovery.stopped` |

Why not `stim_offset_since_rec_start` for the video end? In r4755 it is logged
~3.1 s *after* `stimuli.stopped` on every video — the End Routine code runs
after `video.stop()`, which takes ~3 s to unload the movie. And
`video.stopped` is stamped with the *next* routine's start. `stimuli.stopped`
matches the clip lengths.

```{r epochs}
mmss_to_s <- function(x) {
  p <- str_split_fixed(x, ":", 2)
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(p[, 1]) * 60 + as.numeric(p[, 2]))
}

read_epochs <- function(raw, a, b) {
  stim_path <- col_or_na(raw, "stim_path")
  tibble(
    video_id    = str_remove(basename(stim_path), "\\.[^.]+$"),
    video_label = coalesce(col_or_na(raw, "pos_video_name"), col_or_na(raw, "neg_video_name")),
    nominal_s   = mmss_to_s(coalesce(col_or_na(raw, "pos_duration"), col_or_na(raw, "neg_duration"))),
    psy_cond    = col_or_na(raw, "condition"),
    bl_on   = num(col_or_na(raw, "fixation_baseline.started")),
    bl_off  = num(col_or_na(raw, "fixation_baseline.stopped")),
    vid_on  = num(col_or_na(raw, "video.started")),
    vid_off = num(col_or_na(raw, "stimuli.stopped")),
    rc_on   = num(col_or_na(raw, "fixation_stim_recovery.started")),
    rc_off  = num(col_or_na(raw, "fixation_stim_recovery.stopped")),
    logged_on  = num(col_or_na(raw, "stim_onset_since_rec_start")),
    logged_off = num(col_or_na(raw, "stim_offset_since_rec_start"))
  ) |>
    mutate(
      epoch_type = case_when(!is.na(vid_on) & !is.na(video_id) & video_id != "" ~ "video",
                             !is.na(bl_on) ~ "baseline",
                             !is.na(rc_on) ~ "recovery",
                             TRUE ~ "other"),
      onset_rec  = to_rec(case_when(epoch_type == "video"    ~ vid_on,
                                    epoch_type == "baseline" ~ bl_on,
                                    epoch_type == "recovery" ~ rc_on), a, b),
      offset_rec = to_rec(case_when(epoch_type == "video"    ~ vid_off,
                                    epoch_type == "baseline" ~ bl_off,
                                    epoch_type == "recovery" ~ rc_off), a, b),
      # fall back to the logged recording-clock times if component columns are missing
      onset_rec  = coalesce(onset_rec,  logged_on),
      offset_rec = coalesce(offset_rec, logged_off),
      condition  = case_when(
        epoch_type == "video" & str_starts(video_id, "P") ~ "positive",
        epoch_type == "video" & str_starts(video_id, "N") ~ "negative",
        epoch_type == "recovery" ~ psy_cond,
        TRUE ~ NA_character_),
      video_id    = if_else(epoch_type == "video", video_id, NA_character_),
      video_label = if_else(epoch_type == "video", video_label, NA_character_)
    ) |>
    filter(epoch_type != "other") |>
    select(epoch_type, condition, video_id, video_label, onset_rec, offset_rec,
           logged_on, logged_off, nominal_s)
}

epochs <- sessions |>
  inner_join(clock |> select(session_stem, a, b), by = "session_stem") |>
  mutate(ep = pmap(list(raw, a, b), read_epochs)) |>
  select(participant_id, session_stem, format, ep) |>
  unnest(ep) |>
  mutate(epoch_id = case_when(
    epoch_type == "video"    ~ paste0("video_", video_id),
    epoch_type == "recovery" ~ paste0("recovery_", condition),
    TRUE                     ~ epoch_type),
    duration_s = offset_rec - onset_rec,
    onset_analysis = if_else(epoch_type == "video",
                             onset_rec + params$video_trim_s, onset_rec))

epochs |>
  select(participant_id, epoch_id, condition, onset_rec, offset_rec, duration_s,
         nominal_s, logged_off) |>
  mutate(logged_minus_used_end = logged_off - offset_rec) |>
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "Epochs (recording clock, s). nominal_s = clip length from the conditions file")
```

Checks that should be empty — anything listed here needs fixing in the
conditions file or the stimulus folder before the video can be trusted:

```{r epoch-checks}
epochs |>
  filter(epoch_type == "video",
         (!is.na(nominal_s) & abs(duration_s - nominal_s) > 2) |
         (!is.na(video_label) & video_label != video_id)) |>
  select(participant_id, video_id, video_label, duration_s, nominal_s) |>
  kable(digits = 1, caption = "Videos whose file name ≠ conditions-file ID, or whose played length ≠ nominal length (> 2 s)")

epochs |>
  count(participant_id, epoch_type) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = epoch_type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) |>
  kable(caption = "Epochs per participant (expected: 1 baseline, 4 videos, 2 recovery)")
```

### 3.4 Video ratings (from the PsychoPy file)

Rating rows identify the video by `origional_video_id`, which comes from the
conditions file and can disagree with the file actually played. The
**screenshot file name** (`stimuli/P02_screenshot.png`) is used instead so
ratings join to the video that was shown.

```{r ratings}
read_ratings <- function(raw) {
  first_num <- function(...) coalesce(!!!map(list(...), \(n) num(col_or_na(raw, n))))
  tibble(
    video_id     = str_remove(basename(col_or_na(raw, "screenshot_path")), "_screenshot\\.[^.]+$"),
    rated_as     = col_or_na(raw, "origional_video_id"),
    stim_valence = first_num("stim_valence_slider.response", "stim_valence_slider_A.response",
                             "stim_valence_slider_B.response"),
    stim_arousal = first_num("stim_arousal_slider.response"),
    stim_approach = first_num("stim_approach_slider.response"),
    stim_intensity = first_num("intensitySlider.response"),
    stim_emotion = col_or_na(raw, "emotionText.text")
  ) |>
    filter(!is.na(rated_as) & rated_as != "")
}

ratings <- sessions |>
  mutate(r = map(raw, read_ratings)) |>
  select(participant_id, r) |>
  unnest(r)

ratings |> kable(caption = "Stimulus ratings")
```

### 3.5 FaceReader

For **current** sessions FaceReader's `Video Time` already is time since
recording start. For **older** sessions it is `frame / stored AVI frame rate`,
which drifts from real time (the camera's real rate differs from the rate
written into the AVI). Each FaceReader row is therefore mapped to its frame
number and then to that frame's real capture time in `<id>_frame_timestamps.csv`.
The stored frame rate is taken from the log itself (frames ÷ duration), so
ffprobe is not needed.

```{r load-facereader}
# The FaceReader folder also holds other exports (e.g. heart beat logs), so each
# candidate is peeked at: kept only if it has a `Video Time` header row, and
# skipped without reading if its participant is excluded.
peek_facereader <- function(path) {
  first <- tryCatch({
    if (str_detect(path, "\\.xlsx?$")) {
      read_excel(path, sheet = 1, col_names = FALSE, col_types = "text",
                 n_max = 30, .name_repair = "minimal")[, 1:2] |> setNames(c("k", "v"))
    } else {
      str_split_fixed(readLines(path, n = 30, warn = FALSE), "\t", 3)[, 1:2] |>
        as_tibble(.name_repair = ~ c("k", "v"))
    }
  }, error = function(e) tibble(k = character(), v = character()))
  src <- first$v[str_detect(coalesce(first$k, ""), regex("^file ?name", ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
  tibble(path = path,
         is_detailed = any(first$k == "Video Time", na.rm = TRUE),
         participant_id = if (!is.na(src)) pid_from_file(str_trim(src)) else pid_from_file(path))
}

fr_candidates <- list.files(facereader_dir, pattern = "\\.(xlsx|txt)$", full.names = TRUE) |>
  str_subset("/~\\$", negate = TRUE)                    # Excel lock files
fr_index <- map(fr_candidates, peek_facereader) |> list_rbind() |> filter(is_detailed)
cat(nrow(fr_index), "FaceReader detailed logs;",
    length(fr_candidates) - nrow(fr_index), "other files in the folder ignored.\n")

fr_dupes <- fr_index |> count(participant_id) |> filter(n > 1) |> pull(participant_id)
fr_index <- fr_index |>
  filter(participant_id %in% sessions$participant_id, !participant_id %in% fr_dupes)
if (nrow(fr_index) == 0) stop("No FaceReader detailed logs match a usable session in: ", facereader_dir)

# Older sessions: FaceReader video time -> real time since recording start
legacy_to_rec <- function(fr_p, frames_path) {
  ts  <- read_csv(frames_path, show_col_types = FALSE, progress = FALSE)
  fps_video <- (nrow(fr_p) - 1) / max(fr_p$rec_time)
  k   <- round(fr_p$rec_time * fps_video)                 # AVI frame number, from 0
  fr_p$rec_time <- ts$time_since_recording_start[if_else(k + 1 <= nrow(ts), k + 1, NA_real_)]
  attr(fr_p, "legacy") <- tibble(
    avi_fps = fps_video,
    camera_fps = (nrow(ts) - 1) / diff(range(ts$time_since_recording_start)),
    max_drift_s = max(abs(k / fps_video - fr_p$rec_time), na.rm = TRUE),
    frames_fr = nrow(fr_p), frames_ts = nrow(ts))
  fr_p
}

fr_list <- pmap(fr_index |> select(path, participant_id), function(path, participant_id) {
  d  <- read_facereader(path)
  d$participant_id <- participant_id
  s  <- sessions |> filter(participant_id == !!participant_id)
  if (s$format == "legacy") {
    if (is.na(s$frames_path)) return(NULL)
    d <- legacy_to_rec(d, s$frames_path)
  }
  d
})
names(fr_list) <- fr_index$participant_id
fr_list <- compact(fr_list)

fr_meta <- imap(fr_list, \(d, pid) {
  m <- attr(d, "meta") |> mutate(participant_id = pid, source_video = basename(gsub("\\\\", "/", source_video)))
  if (!is.null(attr(d, "legacy"))) m <- bind_cols(m, attr(d, "legacy"))
  m
}) |>
  list_rbind()
fr_raw  <- list_rbind(unname(fr_list)) |>
  filter(!is.na(rec_time)) |>
  add_composites("fr_")

fr_meta |>
  left_join(fr_raw |> group_by(participant_id) |>
              summarise(n_frames = n(), end_s = max(rec_time), prop_face_found = mean(fr_valid)),
            by = "participant_id") |>
  select(-any_of(c("face_model", "calibration"))) |>
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "FaceReader logs (older sessions: avi_fps = rate stored in the AVI, camera_fps = real rate)")

legacy_checks <- if ("frames_fr" %in% names(fr_meta)) fr_meta |> filter(!is.na(frames_fr)) else tibble()
if (nrow(legacy_checks)) {
  mism <- legacy_checks |> filter(frames_fr != frames_ts)
  if (nrow(mism)) warning("FaceReader frame count ≠ timestamps rows for: ",
                          paste(mism$participant_id, collapse = ", "),
                          " — frame-to-time mapping may be off.")
}
```

### 3.6 Webcam biometrics

```{r load-webcam}
read_sync <- function(sync_path) {
  if (!file.exists(sync_path)) return(tibble(mono_to_global = 0))
  sy <- jsonlite::read_json(sync_path)
  tibble(mono_to_global = sy$mono_reset - sy$global_reset)   # globalClock = core.getTime + this
}

wc_raw <- sessions |>
  filter(has_bio) |>
  select(session_stem, participant_id, format, bio_path, sync_path) |>
  mutate(d = map(bio_path, read_biometrics), sy = map(sync_path, read_sync)) |>
  select(-bio_path, -sync_path) |>
  unnest(c(sy)) |>
  unnest(d) |>
  inner_join(clock |> select(session_stem, a, b), by = "session_stem") |>
  mutate(
    time_source = if_else(is.na(time), "mono_time (arrival)", "time (capture)"),
    rec_time    = to_rec(coalesce(time, mono_time + mono_to_global), a, b) + params$wc_shift_s
  ) |>
  select(-a, -b) |>
  add_wc_aus() |>
  add_composites("wc_")

wc_raw |>
  group_by(participant_id) |>
  summarise(n_frames = n(), start_s = min(rec_time), end_s = max(rec_time),
            fps = (n() - 1) / diff(range(rec_time)), prop_face_found = mean(wc_valid),
            prop_capture_time = mean(time_source == "time (capture)")) |>
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Webcam biometrics logs (recording clock)")
```

### 3.7 Participant overview

Everyone found in the PsychoPy folder, and what happened to them.

```{r overview}
fr_status <- tibble(participant_id = sessions$participant_id) |>
  mutate(fr = case_when(
    participant_id %in% fr_dupes ~ "dropped: several FaceReader detailed logs",
    participant_id %in% names(fr_list) ~ "ok",
    sessions$format == "legacy" & is.na(sessions$frames_path) ~
      "dropped: older session without <id>_frame_timestamps.csv in VIDEO_DIR",
    TRUE ~ "dropped: no FaceReader detailed log"))

overview <- overview |>
  bind_rows(tibble(participant_id = excluded_ids, psychopy_files = NA_integer_, format = NA_character_,
                   status = paste("excluded:", unname(exclude_participants)))) |>
  left_join(fr_status, by = "participant_id") |>
  mutate(status = coalesce(status, if_else(fr == "ok", NA_character_, fr)),
         webcam_biometrics = participant_id %in% unique(wc_raw$participant_id),
         status = if_else(is.na(status),
                          if_else(webcam_biometrics, "included", "included (FaceReader only, no biometrics)"),
                          status)) |>
  select(participant_id, format, psychopy_files, webcam_biometrics, status) |>
  arrange(!str_starts(status, "included"), participant_id)

overview |> kable(caption = "Participants")

analysed_ids <- overview |> filter(str_starts(status, "included")) |> pull(participant_id)
fr_raw   <- fr_raw   |> filter(participant_id %in% analysed_ids)
wc_raw   <- wc_raw   |> filter(participant_id %in% analysed_ids)
epochs   <- epochs   |> filter(participant_id %in% analysed_ids)
ratings  <- ratings  |> filter(participant_id %in% analysed_ids)
cat("Analysing", length(analysed_ids), "participant(s):", paste(analysed_ids, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## 5. Common time grid and epoch assignment

Both sources are averaged into `r params$bin_s`-s bins on the recording clock.
A bin counts as valid for a source if at least one frame in it has a tracked face.

```{r binning}
bin_source <- function(df, valid_col, prefix) {
  df |>
    filter(.data[[valid_col]]) |>
    mutate(bin = floor(rec_time / params$bin_s)) |>
    group_by(participant_id, bin) |>
    summarise(across(starts_with(prefix), \(x) mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop") |>
    mutate(across(starts_with(prefix), \(x) if_else(is.nan(x), NA_real_, x)))
}

fr_bins <- bin_source(fr_raw, "fr_valid", "fr_") |> mutate(fr_ok = TRUE)
wc_bins <- bin_source(select(wc_raw, -starts_with("bs_")), "wc_valid", "wc_") |> mutate(wc_ok = TRUE)

ep_lookup <- epochs |>
  select(participant_id, epoch_id, epoch_type, condition, video_id,
         onset_analysis, offset_rec)

# Every bin inside an epoch, whether or not either source has data there,
# so that validity proportions have the right denominator.
bins <- ep_lookup |>
  mutate(bin = map2(onset_analysis, offset_rec,
                    \(a, b) seq(ceiling(a / params$bin_s), floor(b / params$bin_s) - 1))) |>
  unnest(bin) |>
  left_join(fr_bins, by = c("participant_id", "bin")) |>
  left_join(wc_bins, by = c("participant_id", "bin")) |>
  mutate(fr_ok = coalesce(fr_ok, FALSE), wc_ok = coalesce(wc_ok, FALSE),
         t_in_epoch = bin * params$bin_s - onset_analysis)
```

### 5.1 Data quality per epoch

```{r qc}
qc <- bins |>
  group_by(participant_id, epoch_id, epoch_type, condition) |>
  summarise(n_bins = n(), fr_valid = mean(fr_ok), wc_valid = mean(wc_ok), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(fr_keep = fr_valid >= params$min_valid_prop,
         wc_keep = wc_valid >= params$min_valid_prop)

qc |>
  pivot_longer(c(fr_valid, wc_valid), names_to = "source", values_to = "prop") |>
  mutate(source = if_else(source == "fr_valid", "FaceReader", "Webcam")) |>
  ggplot(aes(epoch_id, participant_id, fill = prop)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(prop, 1)), size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ source) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F4D8CD", high = "#2A9D8F", limits = c(0, 1),
                      labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Bins with face",
       title = "Face tracking coverage per epoch",
       subtitle = paste0("Epochs below ", scales::percent(params$min_valid_prop),
                         " are excluded for that source")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

qc |> filter(!fr_keep | !wc_keep) |>
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "Excluded epoch × source combinations")
```

## 6. Epoch summaries and baseline correction

For every measure: the epoch **mean** and the **95th percentile** (a robust
"peak" — facial responses to video are brief, so a whole-video mean can dilute
a clear response to near zero). Each is baseline-corrected by subtracting the
same statistic from the participant's pre-experiment baseline fixation.

```{r epoch-summary}
measure_cols <- names(bins) |> str_subset("^(fr|wc)_") |> setdiff(c("fr_ok", "wc_ok"))

epoch_long <- bins |>
  select(participant_id, epoch_id, epoch_type, condition, video_id, all_of(measure_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(all_of(measure_cols), names_to = "measure", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(source = if_else(str_starts(measure, "fr_"), "FaceReader", "Webcam")) |>
  group_by(participant_id, epoch_id, epoch_type, condition, video_id, source, measure) |>
  summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            p95  = if (all(is.na(value))) NA_real_ else quantile(value, .95, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(mean = if_else(is.nan(mean), NA_real_, mean)) |>
  # apply QC exclusions
  left_join(qc |> select(participant_id, epoch_id, fr_keep, wc_keep),
            by = c("participant_id", "epoch_id")) |>
  mutate(keep = if_else(source == "FaceReader", fr_keep, wc_keep)) |>
  filter(keep) |>
  select(-fr_keep, -wc_keep, -keep)

baseline <- epoch_long |>
  filter(epoch_type == "baseline") |>
  group_by(participant_id, measure) |>
  summarise(bl_mean = mean(mean), bl_p95 = mean(p95), .groups = "drop")

epoch_bc <- epoch_long |>
  filter(epoch_type != "baseline") |>
  left_join(baseline, by = c("participant_id", "measure")) |>
  mutate(delta_mean = mean - bl_mean, delta_p95 = p95 - bl_p95)

n_no_bl <- epoch_bc |> filter(is.na(bl_mean)) |> distinct(participant_id) |> nrow()
if (n_no_bl > 0) warning(n_no_bl, " participant(s) have no usable baseline — their deltas are NA.")
```

Key measures used in the tests below (edit this list to change the focus):

```{r key-measures}
key_measures <- c("fr_happy", "fr_sad", "fr_disgusted", "fr_valence", "fr_arousal",
                  "fr_au12", "fr_au04", "fr_smile", "fr_frown",
                  "wc_au12", "wc_au04", "wc_smile", "wc_frown", "wc_au_valence",
                  "wc_emo_positive", "wc_emo_sadness", "wc_emo_disgust") |>
  intersect(unique(epoch_bc$measure))
```

## 7. (A) Condition effects: positive vs negative videos

### 7.1 Action-unit profile

Mean baseline-corrected change per AU, by condition and source. The two
sources are on different scales, so compare **patterns**, not magnitudes.

```{r au-profile, fig.height=6}
au_profile <- epoch_bc |>
  filter(epoch_type == "video", str_detect(measure, "_au\\d{2}$")) |>
  mutate(au = str_extract(measure, "au\\d{2}")) |>
  filter(au %in% bs_to_au$au) |>
  group_by(participant_id, condition, source, au) |>
  summarise(delta = mean(delta_mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(condition, source, au) |>
  summarise(delta = mean(delta, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  left_join(bs_to_au |> select(au, label), by = "au") |>
  mutate(au_label = paste(toupper(au), label))

au_profile |>
  group_by(source) |>
  mutate(delta_scaled = delta / max(abs(delta), na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(condition, au_label, fill = delta_scaled)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ source) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#5B8DB8", mid = "white", high = "#E07B54", limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Δ vs baseline\n(scaled within source)",
       title = "Facial action profile by condition")
```

### 7.2 Per-participant condition means

```{r cond-means, fig.height=7}
cond_means <- epoch_bc |>
  filter(epoch_type == "video", measure %in% key_measures) |>
  group_by(participant_id, condition, source, measure) |>
  summarise(delta_mean = mean(delta_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            delta_p95  = mean(delta_p95,  na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("positive", "negative")))

cond_means |>
  ggplot(aes(condition, delta_mean)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(aes(group = participant_id), colour = "grey70") +
  geom_point(aes(colour = condition), size = 2) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 3.5, fill = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_y", ncol = 5) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cond_colours, guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Δ mean vs baseline",
       title = "Baseline-corrected expression by condition (lines = participants, ◆ = mean)")
```

### 7.3 Tests

Paired t-test (positive − negative) per key measure on participant-level means,
plus one-sample tests of each condition against baseline. Holm-corrected within
each family. With small N, look at effect sizes (`dz`) and the plot, not p.

```{r cond-tests}
paired_test <- function(d) {
  w <- d |> select(participant_id, condition, y) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = y) |> drop_na()
  if (nrow(w) < 3) return(tibble(n = nrow(w), diff = NA, dz = NA, t = NA, p = NA))
  diff <- w$positive - w$negative
  tt   <- t.test(diff)
  tibble(n = nrow(w), diff = mean(diff), dz = mean(diff) / sd(diff),
         t = unname(tt$statistic), p = tt$p.value)
}

cond_tests <- cond_means |>
  pivot_longer(c(delta_mean, delta_p95), names_to = "stat", values_to = "y") |>
  group_by(source, measure, stat) |>
  group_modify(~ paired_test(.x)) |>
  group_by(stat) |>
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, "holm")) |>
  ungroup()

cond_tests |> arrange(stat, p) |>
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Positive − negative (paired, participant level)")

vs_baseline <- cond_means |>
  group_by(source, measure, condition) |>
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(delta_mean)),
            mean_delta = mean(delta_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
            p = if (n >= 3) t.test(delta_mean)$p.value else NA_real_, .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, "holm"))

vs_baseline |> kable(digits = 3, caption = "Each condition vs baseline (Δ mean ≠ 0)")
```

Mixed model on video-level data (uses all four videos per participant). Only
run once there are enough participants for a random intercept to be estimable.

```{r cond-lmm}
n_pp <- n_distinct(epoch_bc$participant_id)

if (n_pp >= 8) {
  lmm_results <- epoch_bc |>
    filter(epoch_type == "video", measure %in% key_measures) |>
    mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("negative", "positive"))) |>
    group_by(source, measure) |>
    group_modify(~ {
      tryCatch({
        m   <- lmer(delta_mean ~ condition + (1 | participant_id), data = .x)
        est <- coef(summary(m))["conditionpositive", ]
        tibble(estimate = est[["Estimate"]], se = est[["Std. Error"]],
               t = est[["t value"]], singular = isSingular(m), note = "")
      }, error = function(e) tibble(estimate = NA_real_, se = NA_real_, t = NA_real_,
                                    singular = NA, note = conditionMessage(e)))
    }) |> ungroup()
  kable(lmm_results, digits = 3,
        caption = "LMM: Δ mean ~ condition + (1 | participant); positive vs negative")
} else {
  cat("Only", n_pp, "participant(s) — mixed model skipped (needs >= 8).\n")
}
```

### 7.4 Recovery

Does expression return to baseline in the fixation after each block?

```{r recovery}
epoch_bc |>
  filter(epoch_type %in% c("video", "recovery"), measure %in% c("fr_valence", "wc_au_valence",
                                                               "fr_smile", "wc_smile")) |>
  group_by(participant_id, condition, epoch_type, measure) |>
  summarise(delta = mean(delta_mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(epoch_type = factor(epoch_type, levels = c("video", "recovery"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(epoch_type, delta, colour = condition)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line(aes(group = interaction(participant_id, condition)), alpha = .4) +
  stat_summary(aes(group = condition), fun = mean, geom = "line", linewidth = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ measure, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cond_colours) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Δ mean vs baseline", colour = NULL)
```

## 8. (B) Agreement between FaceReader and the webcam

Three complementary checks:

1. **Lag check** — cross-correlation of **blinks** (FaceReader AU43 vs webcam
   `eyeBlink`) at full frame rate, in 2-minute windows. Blinks are brief and
   frequent, so they pin down the lag to a frame or two; smiles are too slow to
   do this reliably. A constant lag = fixed latency difference between the two
   camera pipelines; a lag that *changes* over the session = drift (serious).
2. **Moment-to-moment agreement** — within-participant correlation over bins
   (all epochs), averaged across participants via Fisher z.
3. **Epoch-level agreement** — correlation of baseline-corrected video means
   (the level the condition tests use).

```{r pairs}
pairs <- bs_to_au |>
  transmute(construct = paste0(toupper(au), " ", label, if_else(approximate, " (approx.)", "")),
            fr = paste0("fr_", au), wc = paste0("wc_", au)) |>
  bind_rows(tribble(
    ~construct,                     ~fr,             ~wc,
    "Smile composite (AU6+12)",     "fr_smile",      "wc_smile",
    "Frown composite (AU4+9+15)",   "fr_frown",      "wc_frown",
    "FR valence vs webcam proxy",   "fr_valence",    "wc_au_valence",
    "Composite valence proxy",      "fr_au_valence", "wc_au_valence",
    "Emotion: happy / positive",    "fr_happy",      "wc_emo_positive",
    "Emotion: angry / anger",       "fr_angry",      "wc_emo_anger",
    "Emotion: scared / fear",       "fr_scared",     "wc_emo_fear",
    "Emotion: surprised",           "fr_surprised",  "wc_emo_surprise",
    "Emotion: sad / sadness",       "fr_sad",        "wc_emo_sadness",
    "Emotion: disgusted",           "fr_disgusted",  "wc_emo_disgust"
  ))

# Which lookup AUs have no FaceReader counterpart in this data (they can't be compared)
tibble(au = bs_to_au$au, label = bs_to_au$label,
       in_facereader = paste0("fr_", bs_to_au$au) %in% names(bins)) |>
  filter(!in_facereader) |>
  kable(caption = "Mapped AUs that FaceReader does not output (dropped from agreement)")

pairs <- pairs |> filter(fr %in% names(bins), wc %in% names(bins))
```

### 8.1 Lag check

```{r lag-check}
lag_grid_s <- 1 / 30
max_lag_s  <- 1
win_s      <- 120

wc_blink <- wc_raw |>
  transmute(participant_id, rec_time,
            blink = row_mean(pick(everything()), c("bs_eyeBlinkLeft", "bs_eyeBlinkRight")))

# corr(fr[t + lag], wc[t]); positive lag = FaceReader registers the event later
xcorr <- function(a, b, max_lag) {
  ok <- !is.na(a) & !is.na(b)
  a <- (a - mean(a[ok])) / sd(a[ok]); b <- (b - mean(b[ok])) / sd(b[ok])
  n <- length(a)
  map_dfr(-max_lag:max_lag, \(L) {
    ia <- seq(max(1, 1 + L), min(n, n + L)); ib <- ia - L
    tibble(lag = L, r = mean(a[ia] * b[ib], na.rm = TRUE))
  })
}

lag_windows <- fr_raw |>
  distinct(participant_id) |>
  pmap(function(participant_id) {
    pid <- participant_id
    f <- fr_raw |> filter(participant_id == pid, fr_valid, !is.na(fr_au43))
    w <- wc_blink |> filter(participant_id == pid, !is.na(blink))
    if (nrow(f) < 100 || nrow(w) < 100) return(NULL)
    grid <- seq(max(min(f$rec_time), min(w$rec_time)),
                min(max(f$rec_time), max(w$rec_time)), by = lag_grid_s)
    fa <- approx(f$rec_time, f$fr_au43, grid)$y
    wb <- approx(w$rec_time, w$blink,   grid)$y
    win <- floor((grid - grid[1]) / win_s)
    map_dfr(unique(win), \(k) {
      m  <- win == k
      if (sum(m) < win_s / lag_grid_s / 2) return(NULL)
      xc <- xcorr(fa[m], wb[m], round(max_lag_s / lag_grid_s))
      best <- xc[which.max(xc$r), ]
      tibble(participant_id = pid, window_start_s = grid[m][1],
             lag_s = best$lag * lag_grid_s, r = best$r)
    })
  }) |>
  compact() |>
  list_rbind()

lag_summary <- lag_windows |>
  group_by(participant_id) |>
  summarise(n_windows = n(), median_lag_s = median(lag_s),
            lag_range_s = diff(range(lag_s)), median_r = median(r),
            drift_s_per_10min = if (n() >= 3) 600 * coef(lm(lag_s ~ window_start_s))[[2]] else NA_real_,
            .groups = "drop")

lag_summary |>
  kable(digits = 3, caption = "Blink lag, FaceReader vs webcam (positive = FaceReader later)")

ggplot(lag_windows, aes(window_start_s / 60, lag_s, colour = participant_id)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_line() + geom_point(aes(size = r)) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1, 3), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Session time (min)", y = "Lag (s)", size = "peak r",
       title = "Blink lag over the session — should be flat")

if (any(abs(lag_summary$median_lag_s) > 0.25 | lag_summary$lag_range_s > 0.2, na.rm = TRUE)) {
  warning("Blink lag > 250 ms or unstable for some participants — check alignment.")
}
```

If the lag is constant, you can remove it by setting `params$wc_shift_s` (added
to every webcam timestamp) to the median lag. This matters for the bin-level
agreement in §8.2 but not for the 60–110 s epoch means.


### 8.2 Moment-to-moment agreement

```{r agreement-bins}
safe_cor <- function(x, y, min_n = 10, ...) {
  ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
  if (sum(ok) < min_n || sd(x[ok]) == 0 || sd(y[ok]) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  cor(x[ok], y[ok], ...)
}

valid_bins <- bins |> filter(fr_ok, wc_ok)

within_r <- pmap(pairs, function(construct, fr, wc) {
  valid_bins |>
    group_by(participant_id) |>
    group_modify(~ tibble(n = sum(!is.na(.x[[fr]]) & !is.na(.x[[wc]])),
                          r = safe_cor(.x[[fr]], .x[[wc]]))) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(construct = construct)
}) |> list_rbind()

agree_bins <- within_r |>
  group_by(construct) |>
  filter(!is.na(r)) |>
  summarise(n_pp = n(),
            r_mean = tanh(mean(atanh(pmin(r, .999)))),
            r_min = min(r), r_max = max(r), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(desc(r_mean))

agree_bins |> kable(digits = 2, caption = "Within-participant bin-level correlation (Fisher-z averaged)")
```

### 8.3 Epoch-level agreement

```{r agreement-epochs, fig.height=6}
epoch_wide <- epoch_bc |>
  filter(epoch_type == "video") |>
  select(participant_id, epoch_id, condition, measure, delta_mean) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = measure, values_from = delta_mean)

agree_epochs <- pairs |>
  filter(fr %in% names(epoch_wide), wc %in% names(epoch_wide)) |>
  pmap(function(construct, fr, wc) {
    x <- epoch_wide[[fr]]; y <- epoch_wide[[wc]]
    tibble(construct = construct, n_videos = sum(!is.na(x) & !is.na(y)),
           spearman = safe_cor(x, y, min_n = 5, method = "spearman"))
  }) |>
  list_rbind() |>
  arrange(desc(spearman))

agree_epochs |>
  kable(digits = 2, caption = "Video-level agreement (Δ mean; rows are not independent — participants contribute 4 videos)")

agree_scatter <- function(x, y, xlab, ylab, title) {
  if (!all(c(x, y) %in% names(epoch_wide))) return(NULL)
  ggplot(epoch_wide, aes(.data[[x]], .data[[y]], colour = condition)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "grey30") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cond_colours) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, colour = NULL, title = title)
}

p_smile   <- agree_scatter("fr_smile", "wc_smile", "FaceReader smile Δ",
                           "Webcam smile Δ", "Smile response per video")
p_valence <- agree_scatter("fr_valence", "wc_au_valence", "FaceReader valence Δ",
                           "Webcam valence proxy Δ", "Valence per video")
wrap_plots(compact(list(p_smile, p_valence))) + plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```

## 9. (C) Link to self-report ratings

Uses the ratings read from the PsychoPy file in §3.4, joined by participant and
the video file actually played.

Expression scores are **person-mean centred** before modelling, so the question
is "when *this* person reacts more to a video, do they also rate it as more
pleasant/arousing?" rather than "do expressive people rate higher?".

```{r self-report}
sr <- epoch_bc |>
  filter(epoch_type == "video", measure %in% key_measures) |>
  select(participant_id, video_id, condition, measure, delta_mean) |>
  inner_join(ratings |> select(participant_id, video_id, stim_valence, stim_arousal,
                               stim_approach, stim_intensity),
             by = c("participant_id", "video_id")) |>
  group_by(participant_id, measure) |>
  mutate(expr_within = delta_mean - mean(delta_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  ungroup()

cat("Videos matched to ratings:", n_distinct(paste(sr$participant_id, sr$video_id)), "\n")
```

```{r self-report-models}
if (!is.null(sr) && nrow(sr) > 0) {
  sr_long <- sr |>
    pivot_longer(c(stim_valence, stim_arousal, stim_approach, stim_intensity),
                 names_to = "rating", values_to = "rating_value")

  fit_one <- function(d) {
    d <- drop_na(d, expr_within, rating_value)
    if (nrow(d) < 8) return(tibble(n = nrow(d), b = NA, r_within = NA, p = NA))
    pp <- n_distinct(d$participant_id)
    r_within <- cor(d$expr_within,
                    d$rating_value - ave(d$rating_value, d$participant_id))
    if (pp >= 8) {
      tryCatch({
        m  <- lmer(rating_value ~ expr_within + (1 | participant_id), data = d)
        co <- coef(summary(m))["expr_within", ]
        tibble(n = nrow(d), b = co[["Estimate"]], r_within = r_within,
               p = 2 * pnorm(-abs(co[["t value"]])))     # Wald approx.
      }, error = function(e) tibble(n = nrow(d), b = NA_real_, r_within = r_within, p = NA_real_))
    } else {
      tibble(n = nrow(d), b = NA, r_within = r_within, p = NA)
    }
  }

  sr_results <- sr_long |>
    group_by(measure, rating) |>
    group_modify(~ fit_one(.x)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, "holm"))

  sr_results |> arrange(rating, desc(abs(r_within))) |>
    kable(digits = 3, caption = "Within-person association: expression Δ vs stimulus rating")

  sr_long |>
    filter(measure %in% c("fr_valence", "wc_au_valence", "fr_smile", "wc_smile")) |>
    group_by(participant_id, measure, rating) |>
    mutate(rating_within = rating_value - mean(rating_value, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    ggplot(aes(expr_within, rating_within, colour = condition)) +
    geom_point(alpha = .7) +
    geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "grey30") +
    facet_grid(rating ~ measure, scales = "free") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cond_colours) +
    labs(x = "Expression Δ (person-centred)", y = "Rating (person-centred)", colour = NULL)
}
```
